title: Independent dev1 review: documented regressions
summary: Claude independently ran dev1 under ooRexx r13196 and real WASM/Chromium in REQ-00003371/REQ-00003373. F1 server config has no transportMode: use HTTPS certificate/key/bridge. F2 one undeliverable target can block endlessly: dead-letter with attempt budgets. F3 pipe characters corrupted plain journal: hex-encode fields with W2/E2. F4 immediate click completion check caused ~55 request/s hot loop: callback must acknowledge after handler; completion must follow mailbox read.
invariants: Core native PASS from dev4 cannot substitute for HTTPS/WASM live end-to-end tests.
An old review is evidence of dev1 behaviour, not proof that dev5 fixes ran on a real browser.
Differentiate LLM/mailbox completion, delivery receipt, and app action from one another.
